# ankra_cluster_stack_variable (Resource)

A variable on one stack of a cluster, the most specific scope: it shadows cluster and organisation variables of the same name when that stack's manifests and add-ons render. Stack variables live in the stack's specification, so every change is a stack update the platform commits to the cluster's GitOps repository and redeploys. The stack must already exist (created through `ankra_cluster`, the CLI or the portal); an `ankra_cluster` apply leaves stack variables alone. The counterpart of `ankra cluster stacks variables set` and `ankra cluster stacks variables delete`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ankra_cluster_stack_variable" "replicas" {
  cluster_id = ankra_cluster.production.id
  stack_name = "platform"
  name       = "replicas"
  value      = "3"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (String) Identifier of the cluster. Changing it replaces the variable.
- `name` (String) Variable name. Changing it replaces the variable.
- `stack_name` (String) Name of the stack. Changing it replaces the variable.
- `value` (String, Sensitive) Variable value. It is stored in plain text in the stack specification and the GitOps repository; marked sensitive so plans do not print it.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `<cluster_id>/<stack_name>/<name>`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Stack variables are imported by <cluster_id>/<stack_name>/<name>.
terraform import ankra_cluster_stack_variable.replicas 6f1c2a40-0000-4000-8000-000000000001/platform/replicas
```
